# Control Point Bounds for every map

Source: [wiki article 4828](../archive/4828.md); edited 2024-11-26.

<a id="wiki-4828-n1"></a>

- Documented capture/contest volumes can differ sharply from painted outlines and have map-specific heights; do not approximate every objective using visible shape or a uniform-height cylinder.

<a id="wiki-4828-n2"></a>

- Gallery legend: blue original outline, white actual shape; missing height preview means volume reaches map ceiling. Source links Patriq's original investigation and verification mode WNSY6.

<a id="wiki-4828-n3"></a>

- Hanamura A can be contested from upstairs window; B from high-ground/stair edges and lantern pillars but not little roof, with reduced height parallel to roof.

<a id="wiki-4828-n4"></a>

- Paris A includes sign edge near water. Anubis A height image explicitly outdated: text gives 9 m to surrounding roofs; Anubis B reaches skybox.

<a id="wiki-4828-n5"></a>

- Volskaya B has exceptions for very-high-ground edge/moving platform and lower height between protruding platforms; ordinary high ground excluded.

<a id="wiki-4828-n6"></a>

- Blizzard World excludes boat top and lowers height near roof. King's Row includes car hood and telephone-box edge. Numbani excludes bushes and area very close to right wall.

<a id="wiki-4828-n7"></a>

- Ilios Well excludes specific wall/stair/indent regions; Ruins includes high-ground edges. Lijiang Garden includes window edges; Control Center includes computer-panel edges/central pillar; Night Market has a corner exclusion.

<a id="wiki-4828-n8"></a>

- Nepal Shrine/Sanctum have contestable windows; Oasis Gardens excludes area near pillars. Remaining entries provide geometry previews for Horizon, Eichenwalde, Hollywood, Busan submaps and other control submaps.

Offline scope: Remote visual/audio previews are not available as offline factual text. Behavioral notes and named API assets are retained; no visual matching or numeric bounds are inferred from absent media.
